criteria.requirement: Add funcy.async_calc.amemoize/acache using real Funcy SkipMemory and positional-vs-keyword key policy. Cache completed successful values, never coroutine objects, isolate values/pending tasks per event loop, singleflight same-key concurrent calls and shield shared producer from one waiter cancellation. Failures/producer cancellation/SkipMemory never cache; canceled waiters may leave a producer running by documented policy. TTL uses injectable monotonic clock from completion, invalidation supports key_func and generation checks so a detached stale producer cannot overwrite newer cache. Provide invalidate/invalidate_all/cache_info, bounded expired cleanup on access and strict options without changing synchronous memoize/cache.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
